Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 12 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Neeta - 42 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Rohan - 12 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Neeta and Rohan stand near him.]

Rohan: "Kunal, what's the plan today?"

[Kunal sings a song.]

Rohan (surprised): "What next?"

[Kunal nods.]

Kunal: "I really enjoyed today."
